about: Which of a conversation's pinned messages show, and in what order, as Slack lists them. pinned is the room's m.room.pinned_events, in the order the messages were pinned; events are the pinned messages the app has loaded, in timeline order; shown lists them as the Pinned messages page does, the most recently pinned first. The SDK loads only a room's 128 most recently pinned messages, so a room with more says how many of them show; total counts its distinct pinned events.

order.name: The most recently pinned comes first
A pin whose message hasn't loaded is left out
A message the room no longer pins is left out
A message pinned twice counts where it was pinned last
A message the timeline holds twice shows once
A message pinned later comes first even if it was sent earlier

limit.name: A room with up to 128 pins needs no note
A room with more says how many show
limit.note: Showing the 128 most recent of 140 pinned messages.
